usedFor: Lulu runs print-on-demand book orders, and Slack is where the team follows them. An “Updated Print Job Status” in Lulu can run “Send Direct Message” in Slack, so one person hears when a job moves.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Print Job Status” in Lulu, then “Send Direct Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The trigger is pushed when a print job changes status, so the person who ordered is told as it happens. The other direction, “Create and Submit Print Order”, ships real books, so test it first.

watchOut: “Create and Submit Print Order” started from a “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” ships to a customer, so a casual message can place an order. Keep that channel narrow. The trigger also includes bot messages.
